The non-standard task list extensions stay off unless asked for:
with plain TaskList these are all ordinary text.

-- parser.json --
{"TaskList": true}
-- mark.md --
- [ ] todo
- [u] unknown
- [T] spawn
- [?] huh
- [✓] check
-- mark.html --
<ul>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> todo</li>
<li>[u] unknown</li>
<li>[T] spawn</li>
<li>[?] huh</li>
<li>[✓] check</li>
</ul>
